Package io.github.janglada.orkit.routing

Class RoutingPlan

java.lang.Object
io.github.janglada.orkit.routing.RoutingPlan
All Implemented Interfaces:
Solution
public final class RoutingPlan extends Object implements Solution
The solved result of a vehicle routing problem.

Routing relies on first-solution strategies followed by local-search metaheuristics, so the solver does not prove global optimality the way CP-SAT does. FEASIBLE is the normal outcome; OPTIMAL is reported only on the rare occasion OR-Tools proves it. A search that hits its time limit before finding any solution reports UNKNOWN; INFEASIBLE means the search space was exhausted.

objective() depends on the goal: total meters for Goals.totalDistance(), variable plus fixed costs plus lateness penalties for Goals.totalCost(), and the vehicle count for Goals.vehiclesUsed(). Routing proves no bound, so Solution.diagnostics() is always SolveDiagnostics.none().

      public RoutingPlan(SolveStatus status, OptionalDouble objective, Duration runtime, List<Route> routes, List<String> unassignedStops)
      Captures a solved routing result.
      Parameters:
      status - solver outcome reported by OR-Tools
      objective - goal-dependent objective value, or empty if no solution was found
      runtime - wall-clock time spent solving
      routes - one Route per vehicle that was assigned stops (empty vehicles omitted)
      unassignedStops - stop ids the solver dropped or could not serve
